I have created and started a **Node.js + Express REST API** with full CRUD endpoints, request validation, error handling, automated tests, and an interactive API Explorer.

### Live Preview & API Explorer
You can explore and test the API endpoints right in the browser here:
**[Open Interactive REST API Explorer](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/3c323e3b-6bdb-4275-9e08-285025c9d6f1/f9f2801e848270e2f0096296/)**

---

### Project Structure

- [package.json](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/package.json) — Dependencies (`express`, `cors`) and scripts (`npm start`, `npm run dev`, `npm test`).
- [src/server.js](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/server.js) — Entry point that boots the HTTP server on `PORT` (defaults to `3000`).
- [src/app.js](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/app.js) — Express application configuration, `/api/health` endpoint, static documentation route, and middleware setup.
- [src/routes/items.js](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/routes/items.js) — Full CRUD router for `/api/items`:
  - `GET /api/items` — List items (with optional `?status=` and `?search=` filters)
  - `GET /api/items/:id` — Get a single item by ID
  - `POST /api/items` — Create a new item
  - `PUT /api/items/:id` — Replace an item
  - `PATCH /api/items/:id` — Partially update an item
  - `DELETE /api/items/:id` — Delete an item
- [src/middleware/errorHandler.js](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js) — [`notFoundHandler`](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js#L4-L10) and [`errorHandler`](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/src/middleware/errorHandler.js#L15-L27) for consistent JSON error responses.
- [index.html](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html) — Interactive REST API Explorer & documentation UI.
- [tests/api.test.js](https://github.com/Barbo-TW/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/api.test.js) — Automated test suite using Node's built-in test runner (`npm test`).
